name: @sf-fight-club/web
description: SF Fight Club web app: arena, Tower, cards, film room, art library.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.demo:data: pnpm run build:deps && tsx scripts/build-demo-data.ts && tsx src/arena/fixtures/generate.ts && tsx src/tower/fixtures/generate.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run typecheck && vitest run
scripts.screenshots: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build && tsx scripts/screenshots.ts
scripts.screenshots:pages: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build && tsx scripts/screenshots-pages.ts
scripts.screenshots:arena: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build && tsx scripts/screenshots-arena.ts
